name: What preventative measures can I take to avoid dishwasher drain line clogs?

mainEntity.name: What preventative measures can I take to avoid dishwasher drain line clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent dishwasher drain line clogs, always scrape food debris off plates before loading them into the dishwasher. Avoid washing large amounts of grease down the drain. Running an empty dishwasher cycle with a cup of white vinegar or a specialized dishwasher cleaner periodically can help break down grease and mineral buildup. Regularly cleaning your dishwasher's filter also plays a significant role. These preventative steps can extend the life of your drain line and reduce the need for professional repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by scraping food off plates, avoiding grease, running vinegar cycles, and regularly cleaning the dishwasher filter.
